name: BTF Small Grants Window

funder.name: Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTFEC)

summary: Rolling small grants in Bhutan for community-based environmental initiatives covering climate resilience, sustainable livelihoods and biodiversity conservation, reviewed every quarter.
reporting: Periodic reporting and compliance reviews are mandatory, and the final 20% of the grant is released on a completion report with invoices.

eligibility.rule: Comply with the Fund's Environmental, Social, Gender, and other relevant safeguards
Keep the project duration to 18 months or less

documents: Complete CV for an individual not associated with any agency
Signed No Objection Letter for an employee of an agency
Government agency forwarding letter routed through DMDF

status.quote: The Small Grants Window remains open throughout the year, and applicants may submit proposals at any time

pool.quote: Annual allocation: up to Nu. 6.0 million

applicant_types.quote: Government agencies, CSOs, CBOs, academic institutions, youth groups, private sector entities, and individuals.

geography.quote: supports environmental conservation, climate resilience, and sustainable development in Bhutan

access.quote: applicants may submit proposals at any time using the prescribed Small Grant Proposal Template

window.quote: The Small Grants Window remains open throughout the year, and applicants may submit proposals at any time

amount.quote: Up to Nu. 1.0 million per project

reporting.quote: Periodic reporting and compliance reviews are mandatory for all funding windows

effort.quote: Applicants submit the completed Small Grant Proposal Template along with the required supporting documents.
The proposals are reviewed by the Small Grant Screening Committee (SGSC)

eligibility.quote: All projects financed through BTF's endowment resources must comply with the Fund's Environmental, Social, Gender, and other relevant safeguards.

after_award.quote: Periodic reporting and compliance reviews are mandatory for all funding windows
Projects are subject to audit by the Internal Audit Unit or external auditors

documents.quote: Proposal from individual not associated with any agency should attach his/her complete CV.
Proposal from employee of any agency, should attach the "No Objection Letter" signed by the Head of the agency.
Proposal from Government agency should have forwarding letter signed by the Head of the department/Dzongkhag and route through DMDF.
